name: Bottom Sheet
structurePatterns: anchored to viewport bottom; top 16px rounded corners; content-driven height with constrained scroll
scrim covers viewport; sheet slides up; at most one modal sheet at a time
optional drag handle centered at top; header with title and optional close; sticky action at bottom
action list uses full-width list rows with 48px min height
usageHints: use for supplementary mobile tasks, not long complex flows (those should be pages)
swipe/scrim/back dismissal disabled when it would silently lose input
safe area padding at the bottom is platform-owned
doNotInvent: no fixed percentage height for every sheet
no close button plus destructive dismissal ambiguity
